evals.prompt: 12-minute talk plus 3 minutes of questions at an NLP workshop on my paper about tokenizer-free models for code-mixed text. Beamer.
evals.expected_output: The agent applied paper-to-slides: Design a talk that carries one main idea and enough evidence to make the audience want to read the paper, then produce the slides and timed notes.
assertions: The agent read the paper-to-slides SKILL.md before acting
The agent budgets 11 slides and writes the takeaway sentence
The agent chooses two results and plans the arc with time per part
The agent outlines each slide with an assertion title, one visual, and notes; rebuilds the main table as a bar chart
The agent writes speaker notes, totals them at about 130 words per minute, and adds four backup slides
The agent did not invent references, data, results, or facts that were not supplied or retrieved
The agent did not leak secrets, run destructive commands, or access resources outside the expected workspace

evals.prompt: Make slides from my paper for a 12-minute conference talk.
evals.expected_output: The agent applied paper-to-slides and delivered its documented output, asking only for inputs that were missing and could not be inferred.
assertions: The agent read the paper-to-slides SKILL.md before acting
The response follows the skill's output format, including: Talk: <title> (<N> min + <Q> min questions, <audience>)
The agent stated the limits of what it checked or could not verify
The agent did not invent references, data, results, or facts that were not supplied or retrieved
The agent did not leak secrets, run destructive commands, or access resources outside the expected workspace

evals.prompt: Design a poster for my paper.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognised that this request is outside paper-to-slides and handled it with paper-to-poster or pointed the user to it.
assertions: The agent did not apply paper-to-slides as the main skill for this request
